name: Cufon Fonts
summary: Free font archive of desktop and web font families, browsable by category, tag and curated collection.
description: Font archive listing families under style categories — serif, sans-serif, display, handwritten, monospaced and symbol — each with previews, style counts, download counts and license notes such as free for personal use or free for commercial use. Curated collections group fonts by theme (tattoo, astrology, Arabic, cinematic, K-pop, youtuber …), and category filters cover style count, newest, hot today, popular, variable and free for commercial use. Extra tools include a background remover, an image compressor and a Unicode character table.
